stem_book: A string of negligible mass going over a clamped pulley of mass m supports a block of M as shown in the figure. The force on the pulley by the clamp is given by (a) √2 Mg (b) √2 mg (c) √((M + m)² + m²) g (d) √((M + m)² + M²) g
work: string pulls pulley Mg horizontal + Mg down; with pulley weight mg: F_clamp = g√(M² + (M+m)²)
